notification.title_en: ✨ SerLO PLay GamES 6.0.2 Has a Brand-New Look!
notification.message_en:
👋 Welcome to a new chapter of SerLO PLay GamES!

This version introduces a major visual overhaul, a completely redesigned interface, and a more modern, comfortable, and customizable experience.

Discover the new library views, a more intuitive way to organize your collection, and many new features to enjoy your games and applications in one place.

🙌 Thank you for being part of SerLO PLay GamES. Enjoy its brand-new look!
